title.suggested: Sullivan Agrees to Sign Articles to Fight Allen

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reprinted a New York dispatch saying Sullivan would sign articles to fight Tom Allen, backed by Richard K. Fox, for $5,000 a side, the battle to be in Colorado or the Indian Territory.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, Tuesday Morning, November 14, 1882; item is a special dispatch to the Cincinnati Enquirer.

facts.fact: Sullivan informed Harry Hill he would be in New York on November 20 to sign articles to fight Allen, and told Fox he would fight for $5,000 a side or any sum, in Colorado or the Indian Territory
Allen held the championship from 1870 to 1876, when Joe Goss won it on a foul blow by Allen

notes: Current title reverses who challenged whom.
